traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.description: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

multiattack_text: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.

attacks.name: Battleaxe
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

attacks.name: Morningstar
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.
